task.description: Hard gate on CODE-DESIGNER's Step 1 output. Read lib/letflow/design/req421-mobile-tenant-bootstrap.md directly -- not step-01's result.summary as a substitute. For each of the 9 acceptance criteria listed in handoffs/WF02-REQ421-20260928/step-01-code-designer.json's task.acceptance_criteria: verify it maps to a concrete design element with no TBD/deferral language, that every function signature is fully specified (name, inputs, outputs, error cases as tagged shapes, not left implicit), that cross-module dependencies are listed, and that no section contains an actual .dart implementation body (signatures/type shapes only). Pay particular attention to: the tenant-not-found rule (first membership entry only, delete-on-mismatch even with a later match), the CANDIDATE 403 fallback, the single-Dio-construction-site rule for api_client.dart, and the docs/mobile/*.md dated-note text being additive-only. FAIL immediately on any check failure -- no partial credit, list every failed check by acceptance criterion.
acceptance_criteria: Every one of step-01's 9 acceptance criteria independently re-verified against the design doc itself, PASS or FAIL stated per criterion
No TBD/deferral language covering a required design element (an explicitly flagged open question that does not block implementation is acceptable and is not itself a failure)
All function signatures fully specified: name, inputs, outputs, error/tagged-result shapes
No .dart implementation code bodies present -- signatures and type shapes only
Cross-module dependencies (flutter_appauth, flutter_secure_storage, dio, routing package, riverpod/whatever REQ-419 established) listed explicitly
